title: Em-dash only in nullable fields; counts and Revenue/Margin are never null
preconds:
1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with all 20 columns enabled.
2. A special-order row is visible, plus an inventory row with no in-window activity that stays in the report via on-hand stock..
steps:
1. On the special-order row, read On Hand, Turns / Yr, Min, and Max.
2. On the no-activity inventory row, read Units Sold, Units Returned, Sold (WO), Sold (Parts Sale), Demand, Revenue, and Margin.
expected:
1. On Hand, Turns / Yr, Min, and Max show — (em-dash) on special-order rows - always.
2. The count metrics and money totals are NEVER null: Units Sold / Units Returned / Sold (WO) / Sold (Parts Sale) show 0.00, Demand shows 0, Revenue and Margin show $0.00.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S3-R9, S5-R5), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 28 August 2026: every requirement this case cites was read again in the live version and the behaviour above still matches it, so only the version cited above was updated.
